name: BNB48 private-tx MEV bot pancakeCall access control
summary: The bot trusted an unauthenticated swap callback caller, allowing a single transaction to transfer its six-token inventory out of the contract.

loss.notes: Gross loss is the exact net ERC-20 depletion of bot contract 0x64dd59d6c7f09dc05b472ce5cb961b6e10106e1d in the single successful incident receipt. It sends 25,912.948173777791158265 USDT, 22,307.554466878046228172 BUSD, 5,160.324984279773039298 USDC, 327.931283327916980816 WBNB, 0.014990282011559361 BTCB, and 0.097450591261976269 ETH, with zero inbound or returned units of any component. Stablecoins are valued at par. The closest preceding DefiLlama observations are BNB $285.3866866195567 at 1663074301, BTC $21,447.84909779573 at 1663074388, and ETH $1,636.5916335063653 at 1663074373, respectively 139, 52, and 67 seconds before the incident. Gas and later recovery are not deducted from gross victim depletion.

ageReset.description: The bot is directly deployed. Its 7,435-byte runtime is absent one block before creation and has code hash 0xa9093034826a8b019fa069caf0368a1a22de1d811b787dff70f740d8d6cebb7a at deployment and immediately before the incident; both EIP-1967 code-selection slots are zero. The unauthenticated callback behavior is in the deployed runtime and does not depend on a later configuration change.

limitations: The 0x64dd59d6 runtime is not source-verified on BscScan; its callback behavior was established from the deployed runtime's incident execution, cross-read against the commit-pinned technical reproduction and published analysis.

sources.note: Reviewed the successful incident receipt and call trace, deployed runtime, direct creation receipt, EIP-1967 slots, commit-pinned technical reproduction, published technical analysis, and three preceding price observations. The anchor is successful at block 21297410 index 8, timestamp 1663074440. Its trace reaches direct bot contract 0x64dd59d6c7f09dc05b472ce5cb961b6e10106e1d, and the runtime execution, receipt, reproduction, and analysis establish that its swap callback trusted an unauthenticated caller and transferred held assets. Every component is an exact Transfer-log net flow from the bot in that one receipt, with no corresponding inflow: 25,912.948173777791158265 USDT, 22,307.554466878046228172 BUSD, 5,160.324984279773039298 USDC, 327.931283327916980816 WBNB, 0.014990282011559361 BTCB, and 0.097450591261976269 ETH. Stablecoins are valued at par; the closest preceding DefiLlama points are BNB $285.3866866195567 at 1663074301, BTC $21,447.84909779573 at 1663074388, and ETH $1,636.5916335063653 at 1663074373. Component values sum to $147,449.04614164584. The bot was directly created by 0x7c58b98bc9860778f0b1e72f945b8ff6fd22e48c in 0x9928da30...7f48 at block 20887989 index 50, timestamp 1661843800. Code is absent one block earlier, and the 7,435-byte runtime hashes to 0xa9093034826a8b019fa069caf0368a1a22de1d811b787dff70f740d8d6cebb7a at creation and immediately before the incident. Both EIP-1967 slots are zero. Deployment is therefore the latest age reset, 1663074440 - 1661843800 = 1,230,640 seconds.

notes: Replaces the seed's rounded $147,449 estimate with exact six-token contract depletion and independently preceding prices for every non-stable component.
